authority: This is the authoritative editorial guide for reader-facing copy. It sits above the voice spec for wording decisions.
finalEditorialTest: Name the placement or event plainly.
Describe the actual situation or behavior.
Use at most one grounded metaphor when it clarifies the mechanism.
Resolve the metaphor with a real consequence, decision, agreement, or next action.
Replace vague scaffolds with the specific object, pressure, behavior, or responsibility.
validationPhrases: the part of you that already knows

families.name: Weight and pressure
families.useFor: Responsibility, expectation, consequence, control, labor, endurance. Saturn, Pluto, 6th, 8th, 10th house.
grounded: You can feel the responsibility before anyone names it.
Their expectations add weight to an ordinary decision.
What began as support starts feeling like supervision.

families.name: Structure and architecture
families.useFor: Agreements, routines, boundaries, roles, durability, maintenance. Saturn, Capricorn, 4th, 6th, 7th, 10th house.
grounded: The relationship has rules, even if neither of you has said them aloud.
The arrangement works because each person knows what they are responsible for.
A promise becomes usable when it includes timing, labor, and consequences.

families.name: Weather and visibility
families.useFor: Uncertainty, changing moods, missing information, mixed signals, temporary conditions. Neptune, Moon, retrogrades, 12th house.
grounded: The information is incomplete, and your mind keeps filling in what is missing.
Their tone is warm, but the terms remain unclear.
Wait until the missing information is available before treating a possibility as a decision.
avoid: wait for the part of you that already knows

families.name: Heat and friction
families.useFor: Desire, anger, competition, irritation, urgency, escalation. Mars, Venus-Mars, Mars-Pluto, squares, oppositions.
grounded: The conversation becomes an argument before either person notices the turn.
Attraction and irritation arrive close together.
Desire creates movement, but it does not settle the terms.

families.name: Motion, pace, and direction
families.useFor: Action, hesitation, timing, change, pursuit, delay, competing methods. Mars, Mercury, Uranus, Jupiter, ingresses, stations, retrogrades.
grounded: One person is ready to act while the other is still gathering information.
Their questions slow you down long enough to catch a mistake.
You keep returning to the same decision because the first answer did not hold.

families.name: Light, attention, and exposure
families.useFor: Visibility, recognition, identity, confidence, projection, scrutiny. Sun, Ascendant, Midheaven, Leo, 1st, 5th, 10th house.
grounded: Their attention makes you more willing to show what you can do.
One compliment stays with you longer than expected.
Being noticed feels encouraging until attention becomes evaluation.

families.name: Sound, language, and signal
families.useFor: Conversation, interpretation, repetition, tone, misunderstanding, clarity. Mercury, Gemini, Virgo, 3rd house, retrogrades.
grounded: You understand what they mean before they finish the sentence.
The same word means something different to each of you.
Repeating the point louder does not make the meaning clearer.

families.name: Distance, room, and access
families.useFor: Autonomy, boundaries, privacy, closeness, availability, unpredictability. Uranus, Saturn, Pluto, 7th, 8th, 11th, 12th house.
grounded: You can remain close without knowing where they are every hour.
Privacy becomes contentious when it is mistaken for secrecy.
Access becomes the argument when one person expects immediate replies and the other expects privacy.

families.name: Cost, exchange, and upkeep
families.useFor: Money, labor, reciprocity, value, maintenance, resentment. Venus, Saturn, 2nd, 6th, 7th, 8th, 10th house.
grounded: You may give freely until you realize no one is checking what it costs you.
Generosity becomes harder to sustain once it is expected.
One person handles the visible gesture while the other handles the upkeep.
